title: Dissociation energy and electronic structure of the low valent lanthanide compound NdF<sup>+</sup>
abstract: The electronic structure and dissociation energy of NdF+ are calculated using equation of motion completely renormalized coupled cluster theory [EOM‐CR‐CCSD(T)]. The potential energy curves of several of the lowest quintet and triplet states in each irreducible representation of C2v symmetry are calculated along with the dissociation energy of the ground quintet state of NdF+. The electronic structure and energies are then compared to those of the analogous compounds NdF2+ and NdF to understand the effect that the Nd 5d and 6s orbitals have on the chemical bonding environment. © 2016 Wiley Periodicals, Inc.
